List URLs, dates, search queries, screenshots, harm context, inaccuracies, changed circumstances and any safety/privacy concerns. Avoid long emotional narratives.

Many publishers do not reply or refuse. The plan should include Google tools, complaints pathways, monitoring and positive search assets as backups.
Do not create new public attention
Publicly attacking the publisher can create new indexed material. Keep the first pathway private and controlled.
